# orchestra_skill (Resource)

An agent skill: instructions an Orchestra agent follows, as a markdown document whose frontmatter gives its `name` and `description`. Set `markdown` to keep the document in Terraform, or `git` to sync it from a file in a connected repository, which Orchestra then keeps up to date. See [Skills](https://docs.getorchestra.io/docs/ai-agents/skills).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A skill held in Terraform. The frontmatter's name and description tell an
# agent when to use it. Usually: markdown = file("${path.module}/skills/triage.md")
resource "orchestra_skill" "triage" {
  markdown = <<-EOT
    ---
    name: triage-pipeline-failures
    description: Find why a pipeline failed and who owns the fix. Use when asked about a failed run.
    ---

    # Triage a pipeline failure

    1. Find the failed run with `list_pipeline_runs`.
    2. Read the failing task's logs.
    3. Say what broke, why, and which team owns it.
  EOT
}

# A skill synced from a file in a connected repository. Orchestra keeps it up to
# date with the branch; Terraform only registers it.
resource "orchestra_skill" "dbt_conventions" {
  git = {
    repository     = "acme/analytics"
    default_branch = "main"
    path           = "skills/dbt-conventions.md"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `git` (Attributes) Sync the skill from a file in a connected repository. Changing it replaces the skill, which detaches it from agents until they are applied again. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git))
- `markdown` (String) The skill document: frontmatter with `name` and `description`, then the instructions. Usually `file("skills/<name>.md")`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description from the document's frontmatter.
- `id` (String) The skill ID.
- `name` (String) The name from the document's frontmatter.

<a id="nestedatt--git"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git`

Required:

- `default_branch` (String) The branch to sync from.
- `path` (String) The file's path in the repository.
- `repository` (String) The repository, as connected in Orchestra.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Skills are imported by ID.
terraform import orchestra_skill.triage 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
```
